desc: Ideation: identified that left-to-right (cost, segments) pair DP is incorrect due to dominance issue; derived clean right-to-left scalar DP formulation.
Implement right-to-left DP: dp[n]=0; for j from n-1 down to 0: dp[j] = min over i in (j+1..n) of (SN[i]+k)*(SC[i]-SC[j]) + dp[i] + k*(SC[n]-SC[i]).
Verify against both examples by hand (Example 1: 110 ✓; Example 2: 985 ✓).
Double-check index-shift argument and off-by-one on k*1 for first subarray (extra k*(SC[n]-SC[i]) term correctness).
Finalize solution in starter code with typing import, prefix sums, large sentinel; confirm O(n²)=10^6 ops fits constraints and 64-bit magnitude (~10^12) is fine in Python.
